objective: Test whether X5F residual carrier-by-time scale interaction can be reduced by a strictly causal leave-one-carrier-out common scale plus a slow carrier component, serving normalized_strength diagnostics only.

primary_source.provider: Sina public index kline retained by X5C

causal_decomposition.common_scale_at_t: median(q_minus_i[u] for u in the W common measurements strictly before t)
causal_decomposition.slow_carrier_component_at_t: median(r_i[u] for u in the K carrier measurements strictly before t)

baselines: V1 raw abs(slope_t) on the same common evaluation rows
X5F static carrier plus calendar-month common-time decomposition as descriptive prior evidence only
X5E causal rolling median-abs findings as prior diagnostic evidence only

stability_gate.cross_carrier_scale_gate: candidate range reduction versus same-window raw >= 50%
stability_gate.temporal_gate: median within-carrier monthly max/min improves by >= 10% versus same-window raw
stability_gate.breadth_gate: at least 4 of 5 carriers have lower monthly max/min than raw
stability_gate.interaction_gate: residual monthly-cell factor max/min < X5F value 2.4080
stability_gate.rule: A stable normalized_strength representation is established only if all gates pass for at least one preregistered candidate. Otherwise retain research-diagnostic status only.
